body: It may be desirable to observe that the whole engine of this inquiry is ordered to run upon a single card whose punching has not been verified: the dataset ds004510. The original description proposed 'OpenNeuro ds000246 or PhysioNet auditory EEG', whereas the spec silently substitutes ds004510 and erects upon it the assumption that it 'contains both simple oddball and complex auditory scene conditions' with a `condition_label` field in `events.tsv`. Should that assumption prove false — and the spec's own FR-008 anticipates exactly this failure by halting with 'research question untestable with current data' — then every subsequent operation, from FR-003's classification onward, is ordered to perform a computation upon symbols that do not exist; the engine has no pretensions whatever to originate a complex-scene condition where the dataset furnishes none. Three further observations: (1) FR-009 and SC-004 are circular in construction, for the 'canonical MMN topography template' is generated from the very same ds004510 simple condition against which it is then correlated, so the r ≥ 0.8 criterion validates internal consistency rather than agreement with any established literature benchmark; (2) FR-011's noise floor, defined as the standard deviation of the pre-stimulus baseline, conflates single-trial variability with the standard error of the averaged difference waveform, and thus the SNR ≥ 3.0 gate is not the criterion it purports to be; (3) the paired t-test of FR-005 presupposes that the same participants contribute MMN metrics to both conditions, an assumption nowhere stated among the Assumptions, though the edge-case exclusion of subjects with excessive artifacts could unbalance the pairing. Finally, the functional requirements jump from FR-006 to FR-008, suggesting an FR-007 was removed without renumbering — a small tear in the weave of the document.
